_readme: Approved changes to the AI prompt files. tests/prompt-guard.test.js undoes these edits and checks the result is byte-for-byte the original prompt (baselineSha256). Any other change to a prompt fails the test. Add an entry here only for a change the owner asked for.

edits.why: Location Note removed from the profile: the AI works out the commute from the Address and the job location.
edits.before: If the role is local to where the candidate lives, reference proximity naturally where it adds genuine value
edits.after: If the role is local to where the candidate lives, reference proximity naturally where it adds genuine value. Work out whether it is local yourself: compare the candidate's Address in the content bank's personal details with the work location in the JD, and estimate the usual travel time from the candidate's suburb to that location from your own knowledge of the area. If it is about 30 minutes or less, you may mention it once in the professional summary, as an approximate figure with the suburb and state only (e.g. "based in Albury, NSW, about 10 minutes from the site"). Never write the street address. Always say "about" or "around", because it is an estimate. If you are unsure of the location or the travel time, the role is fully remote, or the commute is long, leave proximity out, and never invent a willingness to relocate. If the content bank has a "Location note:", use its wording instead of your own estimate.

edits.before: - A specific reason this role or org appeals — mission, location, the work itself, something real
edits.after:
- A specific reason this role or org appeals — mission, location, the work itself, something real
- Location, only if it helps: compare the candidate's Address in the content bank's personal details with the work location in the JD, and estimate the usual travel time from your own knowledge of the area. If it is about 30 minutes or less, you may mention it once, with the suburb only and an approximate figure (e.g. "I live in Albury, about 10 minutes from your office"). Never write the street address. Always say "about" or "around", because it is an estimate. If you are unsure of the location or the travel time, the role is fully remote, or the commute is long, leave it out, and never invent a willingness to relocate. If the content bank has a "Location note:", use its wording instead of your own estimate.

edits.why: New Other Links field in the profile.
edits.before: The portfolio URL from the content bank's personal details is linked wherever the portfolio is named.
edits.after: The portfolio URL from the content bank's personal details is linked wherever the portfolio is named. Any "Other URL (<Name>):" in the personal details (e.g. Facebook, Behance, YouTube) is linked only where it genuinely supports this application, wrapping natural wording such as "my [Behance portfolio](url)"; otherwise leave it out.
